problem_trigger: Repeated mirror-integrity warnings and failed repair attempts consumed controller capacity; provenance messages alone were insufficient to establish exact GitLab content.
prior_design: Routine mirror checks used commit provenance and representative files, followed by ad hoc per-file repair. Reports of divergence could persist without a fresh full tracked-tree comparison.
hypothesis_rationale: Read-only comparison of recursive canonical GitHub and GitLab tracked paths and blob SHAs before writing can distinguish real divergence from stale diagnostics and prevent unnecessary repairs, while preserving GitHub authority.
exact_change: At GitHub main 44607d8525bf195159ffdfd338fc488f79e10a50 and GitLab main 30a0eb80717923c9960f117dec6406ad167b3790, D compared all 115 tracked blobs on each side and found zero path/SHA divergences. No mirror mutation was justified. This records application of existing mirror requirements, not a change to permission, security, scheduler, or governance authority.
expected_benefit: Reduce false mirror-health claims and unnecessary repair attempts.
Protect exact tracked content and failover provenance.
Spend less controller capacity on repeated diagnostics.
risks: Concurrent branch movement can invalidate a snapshot.
Full-tree comparisons cost API calls; do not run needlessly.
A matching snapshot does not establish future mirror freshness.
evaluation_window: Next three healthy D windows and the next canonical main advance.
evaluation_criteria: Never claim current mirror on provenance alone when tracked blobs differ.
Avoid mirror rewrite if a fresh full-tree check shows exact equality.
Reverify mirror after subsequent canonical changes.
Reduce mirror recovery toil over three controller windows.

observed_outcomes.observation: At the checkpoint, 115 GitHub tracked blobs and 115 GitLab tracked blobs had identical paths and SHA values; the mirror provenance message named the same canonical GitHub main SHA.
Live GitHub had one deferred open PR #70 and no active Tier-2 producer PR.
Earlier reported divergences were not present at this snapshot; the mechanism of resolution cannot be inferred.

failures_side_effects: Repeated earlier repair attempts were blocked or incomplete and consumed operational capacity.
Earlier mirror-health messages did not always track actual content.
Root agent/design_history.json append was blocked by execution safety; this checkpoint file is durable pending root consolidation.
lessons: Compare full tracked trees when mirror health is disputed; a provenance commit title is not sufficient.
Do not rewrite a matching mirror.
Treat mirror status as snapshot-specific and reverify after canonical main advances.
Do not infer historical repair causality from current equality.
